## Adversarial Claim Verifier (voter 1/3)

Be SKEPTICAL. Try to REFUTE this claim. ≥2/3 refutations kill it.

## Research question
State of the art (as of July 2026) in AI coding-agent governance and harness design — the problem space of the claude.md-workflow repo: project instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style), lifecycle hooks, deterministic verification gates, persistent agent memory/working-state across sessions and compaction, behavioral guardrails against scope creep/overclaiming/sycophancy, git-level enforcement, task contracts, and parallel multi-agent orchestration (worktree isolation, orchestrator/reduce patterns, adversarial review). Survey and compare best practices from: Anthropic (Claude Code, Agent SDK, skills/hooks/subagents), OpenAI (Codex, AGENTS.md), Google (Gemini CLI/Jules/Antigravity), Microsoft (GitHub Copilot agents, AutoGen/agent frameworks), NVIDIA (agent toolkits/NeMo), xAI (Grok agents/coding); and non-Western labs: Moonshot AI (Kimi K2.5 agentic training), Zhipu/Z.ai (GLM-5.x coding agents), DeepSeek (agentic/tool-use practices), Tencent (recent Hunyuan model launch and agent tooling), MiniMax (M-series agentic models), Alibaba Qwen if relevant; plus respected independents: Nous Research (Hermes 4/Hermes agent), Fundamental Research Labs (Peter Wang co-founder), the team behind the Ornith-1.0 LLM, tinygrad/George Hotz's approach to minimal harnesses, and any other influential open agent-harness projects (e.g. OpenHands, SWE-agent, Aider, Cline, Devin/Cognition). For each: what they prescribe for instruction-file structure and length, memory persistence, verification/eval gating, multi-agent patterns, and prompt-vs-deterministic enforcement. Identify convergent consensus, notable divergences (especially Western vs Chinese lab practices), and concrete, citable insights that should shape a 2026 rewrite of a drop-in governance kit for coding agents. Note if any named entity cannot be verified to exist (e.g. 'Ornith-1.0') rather than guessing.

## Claim under review
"AGENTS.md emerged from a collaboration including OpenAI Codex, Amp, Google's Jules, Cursor, and Factory, and is now stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation — i.e., governance of the format itself has been formalized into a neutral foundation."

**Source:** https://agents.md/ (primary)
**Supporting quote:** "emerged from collaborative efforts across the AI software development ecosystem, including OpenAI Codex, Amp, Jules from Google, Cursor, and Factory ... now stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation"

## Checklist
1. Is the claim actually supported by the quote, or is it an overreach/misread?
2. WebSearch for contradicting evidence — does any credible source dispute or heavily qualify this?
3. Is the source quality sufficient for the claim's strength? (extraordinary claims need primary sources)
4. Is the claim outdated? (check dates — old claims about fast-moving fields are suspect)
5. Is this a marketing claim / press release / cherry-picked benchmark / forum speculation?

**refuted=true** if: unsupported by quote / contradicted / low-quality source for strong claim / outdated / marketing fluff.
**refuted=false** ONLY if: claim is well-supported, current, and source quality matches claim strength.
Default to refuted=true if uncertain.

Structured output only. Evidence MUST be specific.

# AGENTS.md Origins and Stewardship

Yes, the page confirms both points.

**On its origins:** "AGENTS.md emerged from collaborative efforts across the AI software development ecosystem, including OpenAI Codex, Amp, Jules from Google, Cursor, and Factory."

**On current stewardship:** "AGENTS.md is now stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation."

Web search results for query: "AGENTS.md "Agentic AI Foundation" Linux Foundation stewardship"

Links: [{"title":"OpenAI co-founds the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation | OpenAI","url":"https://openai.com/index/agentic-ai-foundation/"},{"title":"Agentic AI Foundation: Guide to Open Standards for AI Agents | IntuitionLabs","url":"https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/agentic-ai-foundation-open-standards"},{"title":"Linux Foundation Announces the Formation of the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), Anchored by New Project Contributions Including Model Context Protocol (MCP), goose and AGENTS.md","url":"https://www.linuxfoundation.org/press/linux-foundation-announces-the-formation-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation"},{"title":"What Is the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)? 2026 Guide - Alatirok","url":"https://alatirok.com/agentic-ai-foundation/"},{"title":"Agentic AI Foundation unites MCP, goose and AGENTS.md under Linux Foundation | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub","url":"https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/linux-foundation-creates-agentic-ai-foundation-to-steward-open-standards-for-autonomous-ai-systems"},{"title":"AGENTS.md : The README Your AI Coding Agent Actually Reads | by OverTheHead | Stackademic","url":"https://blog.stackademic.com/agents-md-the-readme-your-ai-coding-agent-actually-reads-e634b7e2de34?gi=d3510a64786d"},{"title":"MCP joins the Agentic AI Foundation | Model Context Protocol Blog","url":"https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2025-12-09-mcp-joins-agentic-ai-foundation/"},{"title":"AGENTS.md","url":"https://agents.md/"},{"title":"Donating the Model Context Protocol and establishing the Agentic AI Foundation \\ Anthropic","url":"https://www.anthropic.com/news/donating-the-model-context-protocol-and-establishing-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation"},{"title":"AAIF: Linux Foundation Governance for Agentic AI with MCP Goose and AGENTS.md | Windows Forum","url":"https://windowsforum.com/threads/aaif-linux-foundation-governance-for-agentic-ai-with-mcp-goose-and-agents-md.396177/"}]

Based on the search results, here's what I found about AGENTS.md, the Agentic AI Foundation, and Linux Foundation stewardship:

## AGENTS.md Overview

AGENTS.md is a simple, open format for guiding coding agents, functioning as a README for agents. It offers a simple, interoperable standard that gives AI coding agents a consistent source of project-specific guidance needed to operate reliably across different repositories and toolchains. Since its release in August 2025, AGENTS.md has been adopted by more than 60,000 open-source projects and agent frameworks including Amp, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Factory, Gemini CLI, Github Copilot, Jules and VS Code among others.

## Agentic AI Foundation Formation

The Linux Foundation announced the formation of the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) on December 9, 2025, with founding contributions of three leading projects: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP), Block's goose, and OpenAI's AGENTS.md. Platinum members include Amazon Web Services, Anthropic, Block, Bloomberg, Cloudflare, Google, Microsoft and OpenAI.

## Linux Foundation Stewardship

The AAIF is designed to provide neutral stewardship for open, interoperable infrastructure as agentic AI systems move from experimentation into real-world production. The Linux Foundation is a non-profit organization dedicated to fostering the growth of sustainable, open-source ecosystems through neutral stewardship, community building, and shared infrastructure, and has decades of experience stewarding the most critical and globally-significant open-source projects, including The Linux Kernel, Kubernetes, Node.js, and PyTorch.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

input.evidence: Claim survives adversarial check. (1) Quote support: agents.md itself states verbatim that AGENTS.md "emerged from collaborative efforts across the AI software development ecosystem, including OpenAI Codex, Amp, Jules from Google, Cursor, and Factory" and "is now stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation" — the claim is a faithful restatement, not an overreach. (2) Independent corroboration: the Linux Foundation's own press release (Dec 9, 2025, linuxfoundation.org/press/linux-foundation-announces-the-formation-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation) announces the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) anchored by contributions of Anthropic's MCP, Block's goose, and OpenAI's AGENTS.md; OpenAI (openai.com/index/agentic-ai-foundation/) and Anthropic (anthropic.com/news/donating-the-model-context-protocol-and-establishing-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation) published matching announcements; the MCP blog (2025-12-09) confirms the same structure. Platinum members include AWS, Anthropic, Block, Bloomberg, Cloudflare, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI. (3) No contradicting or qualifying sources found; the Dec 2025 event is current as of July 2026. One minor nuance: AGENTS.md was formally contributed by OpenAI (it is described as "OpenAI's AGENTS.md" in the LF release), so "collaboration" describes the format's ecosystem origins while the foundation donation itself was OpenAI's — this does not contradict the claim that governance is now formalized under a neutral foundation.
